capture_status: Partial native capture retained after interruption; further EBS work stopped on explicit priority change. No unexecuted cases are represented as observations.

observations.contract: Overwrites replace bytes; completion accepted four distinct indexes after six uploads. LINEAR checksum hashes concatenated raw SHA256 digest bytes ordered by block index, then base64 encodes that aggregate digest.
An explicitly written zero block is listed and returns the exact 524288 zero bytes, unlike an unwritten hole.
CompleteSnapshot is repeatable after completion, including a changed ChangedBlocksCount; native responses remain HTTP 202 with Status=completed.
Identical StartSnapshot replay returns its original pending response even after completion. Changing Description with the same ClientToken gives HTTP 409 ConflictException.

The old block token remains usable after relisting. The advertised nonempty-list token lifetime was about 585000 seconds; do not infer immediate invalidation from the documentation's statement that tokens change on relist.
Incorrect body checksum returned HTTP 403 InvalidSignatureException, not ValidationException.
Pending snapshot read gives 404 ResourceNotFoundException with SNAPSHOT_NOT_FOUND; pending parent StartSnapshot gives 400 ValidationException with INVALID_SNAPSHOT_ID.
StartingBlockIndex is inclusive and skips holes; beyond-volume listing succeeds empty. MaxResults minimum is 100. Invalid pagination token gives INVALID_PAGE_TOKEN.

boundaries: CloudTrail data events (ListSnapshotBlocks, ListChangedBlocks, GetSnapshotBlock, PutSnapshotBlock) are documented but not captured: no trail or account selectors are changed.
No cross-account principal is available in this probe; region scope is measured and account IAM scope is delegated to the encryption/IAM capture.
Only a few sparse blocks per 1 GiB snapshot are uploaded; an actual multipage nonempty traversal is not forced by uploading 101 blocks.
Natural token expiration was not awaited: AWS advertised approximately 6.77 days. Re-list token reuse and invalid/wrong-index token rejection were measured, not expired-token rejection.

Stopped before completed lineage comparison, inherited-block reads, parent-deletion retention, timeout transitions or post-error admission. Bad changed-count and aggregate requests returned 202 pending, but their terminal outcomes were not observed here.
ListChangedBlocks was exercised only with an omitted first snapshot, returning INVALID_SNAPSHOT_ID; no successful changed-block comparison is claimed.
